record.question: With which country India signed MoU in the field of traditional system of medicine and Homoeopathy during Minister of State for AYUSH Mr.Shipad Yesso Naik's visit to that country?
record.explanation: Answer D: Mauritius. India signed the traditional-medicine and homoeopathy Mo U with Mauritius during Shripad Yesso Naik's 2016 visit. The original PIB ministry release, republished verbatim by Business Standard, explicitly identifies the partner and visit. Reference: https://www.business-standard.com/article/government-press-release/india-and-mauritius-sign-mou-to-promote-cooperation-in-the-field-116041900281_1.html. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
